verdict: Maybe. Watt Technovations pitched PPE kits with built-in ventilation on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal from four sharks. Demand for PPE fell sharply after the pandemic, so the business must now serve steady users such as hospitals, labs and industries.
angle: Healthcare workers, labs and chemical industries need comfortable protective equipment year-round, not just in pandemics. Ventilation and cooling reduce fatigue in hot climates. Certifications and institutional sales are key.
